newsitem.title: USA: National carlot beef trade weekly review - USDA.
newsitem.headline: National carlot beef trade weekly review - USDA.

text.p: Boxed beef trading was very uneven this week on mostly moderate demand and light to moderate offerings, USDA said. Retail interest was light for immediate pre-holiday needs, while some improved forward interest was noted, especially on the Select cuts. Choice middle meat items traded sharply higher on light offerings, however, select middle meats were pressured by an abundance of Select product. Packers were again forced to control inventories and these cuts continued to struggle, consequently all Select cuts traded lower.

Choice cuts were in strong demand for what supplies were available, consequently all Choice cuts traded sharply higher. The light Choice cuts were in the most demand, even through these particular cuts were lightly traded during the week, what was available traded sharply higher.
Most Select cuts traded lower, Select product was in abundance during the trading period, with the most pressure on rib and round cuts.

Closely trimmed items traded uneven on light to moderate demand. with Choice cuts trending higher and Select product trading generally lower. Beef trimmings generally traded higher on light to moderate demand and offerings.
Fed cattle and blended coarse ground items were steady to weak on fairly good demand late in the trading period and offerings were moderate to heavy.

For the week - Rib primal uneven; Choice rib primal $3.00 to $4.00 per cwt higher; while the Select rib primal $3.00 to $5.00 lower; Select and Choice chuck primal steady to $4.00 higher; Round primal uneven; Choice round primal $4.00 higher; Select round primal $2.00 lower; Select and Choice loin primal steady to $3.00 higher; Closely trimmed items uneven, Choice cuts $2,00 higher; Select cuts steady to $1.50 lower; Beef trimmings $2.00 to $2.50 higher; Fed cattle and blended coarse ground items steady to $1.50 higher.

The Estimated Composite of Boxed Beef Cutout values of Choice 1-3 550/700 carcasses Up 3.39 at 118.53; 700/850 Up 2.72 at 116.16; Select 1-3 550/700 carcasses Dn 2.33 at 96.36; 700/850 Dn 1.82 at 95.94.
